 Sione Vaki (ankle) active for Week 10 
 by Chris Schommer | Lions Correspondent | Sun, Nov 15th 2026, 8:14am EST 
 Sione Vaki (ankle) is active for Week 10 for the Detroit Lions. ( Detroit Lions on Twitter ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Vaki will suit up after not suffering any issues during pregame warmups, offering head coach Dan Campbell a stable complementary option behind superstar RB1 Jahmyr Gibbs against the Patriots Sunday.
